заголовок: Bringing Nano Banana 2 to enterprise | Google Cloud Blog

официальность.второй_признак: Автор Michael Gerstenhaber, 'VP, Product Management, Gemini Enterprise' (Google; в тексте и meta authors); og:site_name 'Google Cloud Blog'; текст от лица Google ('Nano Banana 2 is our state-of-the-art image generation and editing model').

картина: Анонс в блоге Google Cloud (26.02.2026) для enterprise-клиентов: Nano Banana 2 (gemini-3.1-flash-image) в preview через Gemini API в Vertex AI и Vertex AI Media Studio. Тезисы: качество Pro на скорости Flash; знание мира из веб-поиска (при этом на Vertex AI — 'coming soon'); рендеринг текста и переводы; апскейл до 2K/4K; нативные соотношения 16:9, 9:16, 2:1; консистентность до 5 персонажей и 14 объектов (зависит от продукта); SynthID + C2PA. Пять отзывов партнёров (Adobe, Figma Weave, Notion, Whering, WPP). Примеров промптов нет.
модели_на_странице: gemini-3-pro-image (Nano Banana Pro, упомянута для сравнения)

единицы.утверждение_en: Nano Banana 2 is Google's state-of-the-art image generation and editing model, delivering Pro-level generation and editing at Flash speed and making Nano Banana Pro's quality, reasoning and world knowledge more accessible.
единицы.цитата: Nano Banana 2 is our state-of-the-art image generation and editing model. It delivers Pro-level image generation and editing at the speed you expect from Flash — making the quality, reasoning, and world knowledge you loved about Nano Banana Pro more accessible.

единицы.утверждение_en: Nano Banana 2 is powered by real-time information and images from web search, which Google says benefits educational tools, localized marketing and travel apps.
единицы.цитата: Nano Banana 2 is powered by real-time information and images from web search. This means better educational tools, localized marketing, travel apps, and more.
единицы.раздел: Why it matters — More accurate visuals
единицы.заметка: Ниже в той же статье уточнено: на Vertex AI эта функция 'coming soon' (E-63-8).

единицы.утверждение_en: Nano Banana 2 includes premium features such as text rendering, translations and upscaling to 2K/4K, enabling cohesive narratives, storyboards and product mockups.
единицы.цитата: We’ve unlocked premium features – from text rendering and translations, to upscaling to 2K/4K. Now, your creative teams can build cohesive narratives, storyboards, and product mockups.
единицы.раздел: Why it matters — Fast, Pro-level features

единицы.утверждение_en: Nano Banana 2 natively supports aspect ratios including 16:9, 9:16 and 2:1, for generating or editing images.
единицы.цитата: Generate or edit images to fit any project requirement, with native support for 16:9, 9:16, 2:1, and more.
единицы.заметка: Полный список не дан ('and more'). Следующая фраза — маркетинг ('vibrant lighting and richer textures').

единицы.утверждение_en: Nano Banana 2 couples SynthID with interoperable C2PA Content Credentials, giving a view of not only whether AI was used but how it was used.
единицы.цитата:
By coupling our state-of-the-art SynthID technology with interoperable C2PA Content Credentials, you can see a holistic and contextual view that goes beyond
if
AI was used, to
how
AI was used.
единицы.заметка: Цитата разбита на строки (выделение 'if'/'how' курсивом в html).

единицы.утверждение_en: At launch, developers could start building with Nano Banana 2 in preview using the Gemini API in Vertex AI.
единицы.цитата:
Developers can start building with Nano Banana 2 in preview using the Gemini API in
Vertex AI
.

единицы.заметка: Идентификатор preview-версии на момент поста; в видимом тексте не назван.

единицы.утверждение_en: Real-time web-search knowledge for Nano Banana 2 was 'coming soon' to Vertex AI at the time of the post.
единицы.цитата: Nano Banana 2 is powered by real-time information and images from web search. This feature is coming soon to Vertex AI, and will help your teams create more accurate visuals.

единицы.утверждение_en: Nano Banana 2 maintains consistency and resemblance of up to five characters and fidelity of up to 14 objects, with the exact figures varying by product and surface.
единицы.цитата: Maintain the consistency and resemblance of up to five characters and the fidelity of up to 14 objects (varies by product and surface), making it easy to build narratives and create collateral with accurate inputs.
единицы.заметка: Потолки 5 персонажей / 14 объектов; оговорка 'varies by product and surface'.

единицы.утверждение_en: Nano Banana 2 renders accurate text directly into images, which can help create materials and speed up editing, from marketing mockups to greeting cards.
единицы.цитата: Nano Banana 2 renders accurate text directly into your images, which can help you create better materials and speed up the editing process, from marketing mockups to greeting cards.
единицы.раздел: Deep dive — Text rendering and localization

единицы.утверждение_en: Words of a partner (Adobe Firefly, not Google): Nano Banana 2 is available in Adobe Firefly and gives creators greater control to generate and refine production-ready work.
единицы.цитата: Nano Banana 2 in Firefly sets a new standard for image quality and precision, giving creators greater control to generate and refine production-ready work in a seamless workflow.
единицы.раздел: How customers are already using Nano Banana 2
единицы.заметка: Слова не Google: Steve Newcomb, Adobe Firefly.

единицы.утверждение_en: Words of a partner (Figma Weave, not Google): Gemini 3.1 Flash stays responsive to direction even after many rounds of edits, with quality approaching Pro at faster speeds.
единицы.цитата: It stays responsive to our direction even after many rounds of edits, and the quality approaches Pro-level at faster speeds.
единицы.раздел: How customers are already using Nano Banana 2
единицы.заметка: Слова не Google: Itay Schiff, Figma Weave (Weavy). В отзыве модель названа 'Gemini 3.1 Flash' — по контексту NB2 (Gemini 3.1 Flash Image).

единицы.утверждение_en: Words of a partner (Notion, not Google): Gemini handles diagrams for specs, visuals for team updates and comics, and is fast enough that users treat image generation like text.
единицы.цитата: And it's fast enough that people stop treating image generation as a separate step and start using it the way they use text, as just another way to get an idea down.
единицы.раздел: How customers are already using Nano Banana 2
единицы.заметка: Слова не Google: Jimmy Liu, Notion. Модель названа просто 'Gemini'.

единицы.утверждение_en: Words of a partner (Whering, not Google): Gemini 3.1 Flash Image transforms low-quality user photos into studio-grade assets while preserving authentic textures, and returns structured, predictable outputs.
единицы.цитата: Whering has been able to transform low-quality user photos into professional, studio-grade assets while preserving authentic textures. Its ability to return structured, predictable outputs has allowed our team to build quickly
единицы.раздел: How customers are already using Nano Banana 2
единицы.заметка: Слова не Google: Bianca Rangecroft, Whering.

единицы.утверждение_en: Words of a partner (WPP, not Google): Nano Banana 2's enhanced world knowledge anchored output in factual accuracy, and with better reasoning and text fidelity it reduced editing time for product representation from hours to seconds.
единицы.цитата: finding that the enhanced world knowledge anchored output in factual accuracy. Combined with improvements in reasoning and text fidelity, this model shows significant promise for verticals where high fidelity product representation is paramount, reducing editing time from hours to seconds.
единицы.раздел: How customers are already using Nano Banana 2
единицы.заметка: Слова не Google: Elav Horwitz, WPP (ранний доступ, тесты с Unilever).

длинная_дистанция.утверждение_en: The post presents real-time web-search grounding as a Nano Banana 2 capability but also says it is 'coming soon' to Vertex AI, so at the post date it was not yet available on the enterprise surface being announced.
The post twice frames 2K/4K as 'upscaling' ('upscaling to 2K/4K', 'Quality and 4k upscaling') rather than native generation resolution, and gives no base resolution.
длинная_дистанция.как_получено: выведено из E-63-3 и заголовка 'Quality and 4k upscaling' (строка 88)

противоречия_внутри: Веб-поиск подан как действующая возможность ('is powered by real-time information…', E-63-2), но в разделе Deep dive сказано, что на Vertex AI функция 'coming soon' (E-63-8).
не_сказано: Нет полного списка соотношений сторон ('and more') и базового разрешения; 2K/4K названы апскейлом.
Не сказано, сколько входных картинок принимает модель — даны только 5 персонажей / 14 объектов с оговоркой 'varies by product and surface'.
Не сказано, как включается C2PA и где его видно.
Нет срока выхода из preview и срока появления веб-поиска на Vertex AI.
Примеров промптов нет — только ссылка на prompting guide.
сомнения: В отзыве Figma Weave модель названа 'Gemini 3.1 Flash' (без 'Image'); сопоставлено с NB2 по контексту.
Имя файла иллюстрации в html 'GEMPIX_2_OUTPUT_sutro_tower' — возможно, внутреннее кодовое имя; в тексте не упоминается.
